meta.title: Token Launch Radar — radar-3.1: fitted peer pricing, held-out twice, costed farm verdicts on all 758 protocols

calibration.comparables_rule: priced live-token peers only: mcap_usd > 0 with CoinGecko id and symbol (16 zero/negative-mcap dead tokens excluded)
calibration.pricing_rule: headline multiple is the fitted log-curve C(TVL) = 10^(a + b*log10(TVL)), OLS on the 128 priced comparables (a=3.0247, b=-0.4777, R2=0.17); no category median, no cap — the category median was tested and rejected (it did not beat the single curve out of sample)
calibration.interval_rule: per-row 80% interval = 10th/90th percentiles of the curve's leave-one-out log prediction errors on the 128 priced comparables, applied to the final implied value
calibration.stability_note: snapshot carries no 30-day TVL series, so stability S = 1.00 for every row

formulas.implied: implied_i = TVL_i × C(TVL_i) × G_i × A_i × B_i × S_i, C(TVL) = 10^(3.0247 − 0.4777·log10(TVL))
formulas.ev_farm: EV = p_launch × E[airdrop|launch] − total_costs − capital × 4.2% × hold_days/365
